anyOf.description: A target that is another account of an Agent, declared under targets with agent and config_dir. Global config only.

directTools.description: Converted since 0.23.0: pi-mcp-adapter's setting becomes Pi's exposure (true: direct, "search": deferred) in piOptions, or piOptions.toolExposure for a list of tool names; a default under mcp or a project applies to each server that reaches Pi. Saving the config drops it.

items.description: A tool name; * matches any characters.

tools.description: Which of the server's tools reach the model, translated per Agent. Pi holds all of it; Codex and Copilot take exact tool names; the plan and mcp check name each Agent that cannot hold a part.

expose.description: How the model reaches the tools: declared directly, loaded through tool search, or hidden. Unset leaves each Agent's default.

allow.description: Only the tools that match are available.

deny.description: The tools that match are never available; deny beats allow.

projects.description: Project folders this global config syncs into, keyed by absolute path (or ~/...). Each takes what that project's own config.yaml would hold under mcp.

piExtension.description: Ignored since 0.23.0: Pi always uses its built-in MCP. Saving the config drops it.

piOptions.description: Pi built-in per-server options. Known built-in fields are validated; unknown fields are preserved. pi-mcp-adapter-only fields are refused: set tool lists in tools; exposure and toolExposure cannot be combined with tools.

piOptionsPrune.description: Ignored since 0.23.0: sync always removes Pi options Skillshare wrote that are unchanged. Saving the config drops it.

disabled.description: Project mode only: turn off a server that the Agent's global config defines. Supported by claude, opencode and kilocode.
